description: Each transaction's value is signed by its direction: credits ('PRIJEM') are positive and withdrawals ('VYDAJ') are negative. Transactions of any other type are excluded from the average.

b.request: Identify accounts whose average transaction amount (with credits 'PRIJEM' coded as positive and withdrawals 'VYDAJ' coded as negative, excluding all other transaction types) exceeds the overall average transaction amount calculated the same way, ranked by excess in descending order, displaying account_id, the account's average, and the excess value, unrounded.
b.sql:
WITH signed_transactions AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount
      WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount
    END AS signed_amount
  FROM trans
  WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(signed_amount) AS overall_average
  FROM signed_transactions
),
account_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    AVG(signed_amount) AS account_average
  FROM signed_transactions
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
  a.account_id,
  a.account_average,
  a.account_average - o.overall_average AS excess
FROM account_avgs a
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE a.account_average > o.overall_average
ORDER BY excess DESC;
b.raw: Identify accounts whose average transaction amount (with credits 'PRIJEM' coded as positive and withdrawals 'VYDAJ' coded as negative, excluding all other transaction types) exceeds the overall average transaction amount calculated the same way, ranked by excess in descending order, displaying account_id, the account's average, and the excess value, unrounded.

a.request: For each account (`trans.account_id`), compute the average transaction amount, treating credits ('PRIJEM') as positive and withdrawals ('VYDAJ') as negative and ignoring transactions of any other or missing type. Then take the mean of these per-account averages. List the accounts whose average is strictly above that mean, showing the account id, its average, and how far above the mean it is. Show the top 10 by that difference, largest first, unrounded.
a.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) as avg_amount FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_avg FROM account_averages) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.avg_amount, aa.avg_amount - om.mean_avg as difference_from_mean FROM account_averages aa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE aa.avg_amount > om.mean_avg ORDER BY difference_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: Accounts whose average transaction amount (PRIJEM positive, VYDAJ negative, other transaction types excluded) exceeds the overall average of all such signed transactions, ranked by the excess amount, showing top 10 unrounded with account_id, average, and excess.
d.sql:
WITH signed_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    amount * CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -1 END as signed_amount
  FROM trans
  WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
),
account_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    AVG(signed_amount) as avg_amount
  FROM signed_transactions
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(signed_amount) as overall_avg
  FROM signed_transactions
)
SELECT 
  aa.account_id,
  aa.avg_amount as average,
  aa.avg_amount - oa.overall_avg as excess
FROM account_averages aa
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE aa.avg_amount > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10

c.request: Which accounts have an average transaction amount above the average across all accounts? Give the account id, its average, and how much it exceeds the overall average. Show the top 10 by that excess, biggest first, unrounded. Each transaction's value is signed by its direction: credits ('PRIJEM') are positive and withdrawals ('VYDAJ') are negative. Transactions of any other type are excluded from the average.
c.sql: WITH signed_trans AS (SELECT account_id, CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END as signed_amount FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(signed_amount) as overall_average FROM signed_trans), account_avgs AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(signed_amount) as account_average FROM signed_trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT a.account_id, a.account_average, a.account_average - o.overall_average as excess FROM account_avgs a CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE a.account_average > o.overall_average ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
